summary: PASS on candidate sha256:05915c32...91babd (source 273d21f). The D-055 default-deny change closes F-DG1-129 / F-DG1-213. The process._debugProcess / process.kill SIGUSR1 routes and every other non-allow-listed built-in (72 enumerated) and process member (120 enumerated) on the running Node are denied. The safe set stays clean, and no real module import is wrongly denied. Negative controls and a real-file plant show that the checks discriminate. The change is test-only; unit 294/294, integration 200/200 twice with no 57P01, e2e 22/22 EN+AR (F-DG1-210 holds), A12/A13/A14/A18/A20 green. The F-DG1-212 14-case log is unchanged. One sub-check is BLOCKED by missing network (live AC-1 effect); it does not affect the verdict, because the cited 14-case log and an offline equivalent cover it. No new findings.
